entities.summary: Central African Federation, a political institution in Malawi during Nyasaland Protectorate (1953–1963). Grew from John Chilembwe Uprising 1915 and Chilembwe Uprising 1915. Led to the emergence of Federation of Rhodesia and Nyasaland and Malawi Congress.
